result_text:
The region overview now lists open tickets high priority first, then normal, then low, oldest first within each priority. Closed tickets and other regions are still excluded.

The change is in `DataStore.listOpenSupportTicketsByRegion` (`src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`). Its `ORDER BY` now matches the sales-rep query: `CASE priority WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 0 WHEN 'NORMAL' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, opened_date, id`. I also updated the method's comment to describe the new order. This query is only used by the region overview, so nothing else changes.

I added `openTicketsOfTheRegionAreListedByPriorityThenOldestFirst` to `RegionManagerTest`. It uses your example data plus a closed high-priority ticket and asserts T-3, T-5, T-2, T-4, T-1. `RegionManagerTest` passes (6 tests, 0 failures). Nothing is committed.
